nodes.name: bc_unassigned_concepts.html
nodes.summary: Report page listing CDISC Library biomedical concepts that are not classified under any biomedical concept category, with an htmx-triggered report generator and a CSV export link.

nodes.name: bc_unassigned_results.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial fragment rendering the table of unassigned biomedical concepts, swapped into bc_unassigned_concepts.html after report generation.

nodes.name: cdash_terminology.html
nodes.summary: CDASH controlled terminology browser page with a multi-field filter form, paginated results table, and a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action.

nodes.name: cdisc_api_status.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial status badge indicating whether the CDISC Library API is connected, missing a key, erroring, or running in offline mode.

nodes.name: concept_categories.html
nodes.summary: Lists CDISC Library biomedical concept categories with a client-side search filter, cache refresh action, and links to each category's concept listing.

nodes.name: concept_category_detail.html
nodes.summary: Detail page listing the biomedical concepts that belong to a single CDISC concept category, with links to each concept's detail page.

nodes.name: concept_detail.html
nodes.summary: Detail page for a single CDISC Library biomedical concept, showing its summary attributes, parent BC/package links, data element concepts table, and raw JSON.

nodes.name: concept_groups.html
nodes.summary: Page for managing global custom biomedical concept groups (create, edit, delete, assign concepts/surrogates/CDISC categories) alongside a lazy-loaded CDISC BC Groupings explorer widget.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of Jinja `{% set %}` namespaces and inline onclick handlers to manage collapsible group cards without a JS framework.

nodes.name: concepts_cell.html
nodes.summary: SoA activity-matrix table-cell partial for assigning and removing biomedical concepts, concept groups, CDISC categories, and BC surrogates on an activity, with inline bulk-edit mode.

nodes.name: concepts_list.html
nodes.summary: Lists all CDISC Library biomedical concepts with a client-side search filter and links to each concept's detail page and related SDTM Dataset Specializations.

nodes.name: condition_assignments.html
nodes.summary: Thin page wrapper that extends the base layout and includes the condition assignments section partial.

nodes.name: crf_cell.html
nodes.summary: SoA activity-matrix table-cell partial for assigning CRF (Case Report Form) specializations to biomedical concepts on an activity, with lazy-loaded HTMX option lists.

nodes.name: crf_specialization_detail.html
nodes.summary: Detail page rendering a single CRF specialization's scalar fields, dynamically-detected item/field sub-table, and raw JSON as returned by the CDISC Library CRF Specializations API.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Jinja `namespace()` and dynamic key probing across candidate field names (items/fields/dataElementConcepts/etc.) to render heterogeneous API payloads generically.

nodes.name: crf_specializations.html
nodes.summary: Lists CRF specializations retrieved from the CDISC Library CRF API with a client-side search filter, refresh action, and links to each specialization's detail page.

nodes.name: dair.html
nodes.summary: Page for generating a Digital Amendment Impact Report (DAIR) by selecting base and revised study snapshots and downloading a .docx comparison of structural protocol changes.

nodes.name: ddf_controlled_terminology.html
nodes.summary: DDF (Digital Data Flow) controlled terminology browser page with a multi-field filter form, paginated results table, and a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action.

nodes.name: decision_instances.html
nodes.summary: Thin page wrapper that extends the base layout and includes the decision instances section partial.

nodes.name: define_json.html
nodes.summary: Page for downloading the experimental Data Definition Specification (DDS) JSON, with form fields for SDTM CT date, SDTM IG version, and Cosmos API version.

nodes.name: define_xml_terminology.html
nodes.summary: Define-XML controlled terminology browser page with a multi-field filter form, paginated results table, and a refresh-from-CDISC-Library action.

nodes.name: dss_cell.html
nodes.summary: SoA activity-matrix table-cell partial for assigning Dataset Specialization (DSS) records to biomedical concepts on an activity, with lazy-loaded HTMX option lists, mirroring crf_cell.html.
